description.value: Oak Bay Recreation Centre is a full-service municipal sports and recreation facility operated by Recreation Oak Bay in the seaside District of Oak Bay, adjacent to Victoria. It offers a range of registered and drop-in programs across fitness, aquatics, and active living. As a community hub near popular cycling routes on southern Vancouver Island, it is a plausible rest and refresh stop for touring cyclists.
